title: Downtime - Offline Puzzle Games for Android
excerpt: Two complete puzzle games for Android that work with no internet at all. No adverts, no account, no data collected.
content_html:
Offline puzzle games for flights and commutes.

The overall idea for this application was based on my own experience when travelling on business trips and regularly commuting to the office. Most of the games I tried did require an online connection, or wasted my time waiting for and watching ads, or would require a significant time investment to learn and skill up, and overall longer time commitment.

As a result, I developed my own application with multiple mini-games - minimal learning curve, you can quickly open and play the games in short sessions, and can be played fully offline (even in airplane mode) without any data collected about you.

At the start, it only includes 2 games:

Tight Fit - a traditional fast-paced game with falling blocks.

Carry On - where you need to push boxes into their marked spots. There are 99 levels in total, most of them from David W. Skinner's classic Microban set.

Free, no adverts

You can play it by swiping on screen, or using on-screen buttons, change between dark and light themes, portrait or landscape - choose what is more convenient for you.

I hope you will enjoy the application, and it will help you to fill your time during commutes or off-grid times. And please share your feedback and ideas for improvement and further development to gennadiygryva@gmail.com.

content_html_zh:
适用于航班和通勤的离线益智游戏。

该应用程序的总体想法是基于我自己出差旅行和定期上班通勤时的经验。 我尝试过的大多数游戏确实需要在线连接，或者浪费我的时间等待和观看广告，或者需要投入大量时间来学习和提高技能，以及总体上更长的时间投入。

因此，我开发了自己的应用程序，其中包含多个迷你游戏 - 最小的学习曲线，您可以在短时间内快速打开并玩游戏，并且可以完全离线玩（即使在飞行模式下），而无需收集有关您的任何数据。

一开始，它只包含 2 款游戏：

Tight Fit - 一款传统的快节奏游戏，块体会掉落。

继续 - 您需要将箱子推入其标记的位置。 总共有 99 个关卡，其中大部分来自 David W. Skinner 的经典妙抗保套装。

免费、无广告

您可以通过在屏幕上滑动或使用屏幕按钮来播放它，在深色和浅色主题、纵向或横向之间切换 - 选择对您更方便的方式。

我希望您会喜欢该应用程序，它将帮助您打发通勤或离网时间的时间。 请将您的反馈和改进和进一步发展的想法发送至 gennadiygryva@gmail.com。
